location_description: Bethel () is a town in Fairfield County, Connecticut, United States. Its population was 11,988 in 2022 according to World Population Review. The town includes the Bethel Census Designated Place.Interstate 84 passes through Bethel, and it has a train station on the Danbury Branch of Metro-North's New Haven Line.
